name: sqlite
description: SQLite database engine with command-line tools for database management and analysis

sqldiff.description: Compare and display differences between two SQLite database files
sqldiff.usage:
sqldiff database1.db database2.db
sqldiff --summary db1.db db2.db
sqldiff --changeset changes.db db1.db db2.db
sqldiff --table users db1.db db2.db

sqlite3.description: SQLite command-line shell for database operations and queries
sqlite3.usage:
sqlite3 database.db
sqlite3 -header -csv database.db 'SELECT * FROM users;'
sqlite3 database.db < schema.sql
sqlite3 -bail database.db '.dump' > backup.sql
sqlite3 ':memory:'

sqlite3-analyzer.description: Analyze SQLite database structure and provide detailed storage statistics
sqlite3-analyzer.usage:
sqlite3_analyzer database.db
sqlite3_analyzer database.db > report.txt
sqlite3_analyzer --help

sqlite3-rsync.description: Synchronize SQLite databases over network connections with incremental updates
sqlite3-rsync.usage:
sqlite3_rsync client.db server_url
sqlite3_rsync --server database.db
sqlite3_rsync --download remote.db local.db
sqlite3_rsync --verbose client.db server
